purpose: One method contract shared by course explanation, executable skill and acceptance cases.
coverage: Incremental implemented kernel; not the complete course or universal method library.

competencies.knowledge: SANRA evaluates six aspects of the whole narrative manuscript. Its score does not establish factual correctness or clinical certainty.
competencies.decision: Use the adapted six-item rules only after scope verification and full coverage. Preserve NO_INFORMATION and suppress sum scores until all items resolve.
competencies.output: Six reasoned item scores; optional sum without a universal quality category

competencies.knowledge: RoB2 2019 evaluates a specific trial result. D2 differs by assignment/adhering effect, NI is question-specific, and technical abstention is not an instrument response. Overall multiple concerns need qualitative review.
input: explicit signalling responses with bound source reasons/locators
D2 effect and adhering deviation choices
competencies.decision: Apply the original decision diagrams only to permitted active responses. Preserve HOLD, proposals and explained overrides; require an explicit combined-concerns judgement when applicable, never a sum score.
competencies.output: Five traced domain proposals plus overall proposal or HOLD; semantic_acceptance and claim_use_allowed remain false

competencies.knowledge: An appraisal belongs to a specific source version, assessment unit and protocol; changed inputs invalidate unqualified reuse.
competencies.decision: Reject changed bytes or mismatched unit/protocol before interpreting the draft.
competencies.output: DRAFT_BINDINGS_VALID or HOLD, never semantic acceptance

competencies.knowledge: Information unavailable to an appraiser differs from information absent after whole-document examination. The tool controls how reported absence affects its judgment.
competencies.decision: An absence answer requires a controller record covering all supplied sources with no unresolved components and a named search method. Otherwise preserve NO_INFORMATION.
competencies.output: ABSENCE_NOT_ESTABLISHED or draft binding result; coverage attestation is not automatically truthful

competencies.knowledge: A fair comparison uses matched sources, methods and assessment units; agreement and correctness are different endpoints.
competencies.decision: Reject mismatched inputs and same-model arms. Include failed or missing outputs in the planned denominator. Adjudicate against sources before equivalence claims.
competencies.output: Paired and planned agreement, per-question discordance, unresolved acceptance requirements

competencies.knowledge: Specify who was blinded, to which information and at what phase; do not transfer one role's blinding to another.
competencies.decision: Extract role and concealed information separately before applying a design-specific method.
competencies.output: Role-specific facts with supporting source quotes
